_comment: Egg exported by Waifly - custom combined NodeJS + Python runtime, self-built image. Version of each runtime selectable independently.
name: NodeJS + Python Universal (Waifly)
author: a.devogelaere@siweb.fr
description:
Combined Node.js + Python egg using Waifly's own self-built image (eggs.waifly.com/waifly-eggs/node-python). Both toolchains are installed in the same image with several versions each; pick RUNTIME (node or python) and the exact version of that runtime independently via NODE_VERSION / PYTHON_VERSION.

Clones a Git repo (or use USER_UPLOAD if you upload files yourself), installs dependencies (node_modules or requirements.txt depending on RUNTIME), then runs the app.

config.startup: {"done":["change this text to something your app prints once it is ready"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Node.js + Python App Installation Script (Waifly combo egg)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

NODE_VERSION="${NODE_VERSION:-22}"
PYTHON_VERSION="${PYTHON_VERSION:-3.12.7}"

if [[ -d "/usr/local/nodeversions/${NODE_VERSION}/bin" ]]; then
    export PATH="/usr/local/nodeversions/${NODE_VERSION}/bin:${PATH}"
else
    export PATH="/usr/local/nodeversions/22/bin:${PATH}"
fi
export PYENV_VERSION="${PYTHON_VERSION}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "USER_UPLOAD is set, skipping git clone. Upload your files manually."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anonymous git access"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server is not empty"
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
    fi
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo -e "pulling latest from git"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty, cloning repo"
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

if [ "${RUNTIME}" == "python" ]; then
    pip install --upgrade pip
    if [ -f "/mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}" ]; then
        echo "Installing requirements from ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}"
        pip install --no-cache-dir -r "/mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}"
    fi
    if [[ ! -z ${PY_PACKAGES} ]]; then
        pip install --no-cache-dir ${PY_PACKAGES}
    fi
else
    echo "Installing npm packages"
    if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
        npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
    fi
    if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
        npm install --production
    fi
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Runtime
variables.description: Which runtime to use: node or python.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Node.js version to use when RUNTIME=node. One of: 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26.

variables.name: Python Version
variables.description: Python version to use when RUNTIME=python. One of: 3.8.20, 3.9.20, 3.10.15, 3.11.10, 3.12.7, 3.13.0, 3.14.0.

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: GitHub/GitLab repo to clone, e.g. https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Install Branch
variables.description: The branch to install. Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip the git clone if you are uploading files yourself.
0 = false (default), 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files from git on every startup.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username to authenticate with git (optional, for private repos).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token to authenticate with git (optional, for private repos).

variables.name: Main file (Node.js)
variables.description: The file that starts the app when RUNTIME=node. Can be .js or .ts

variables.name: Additional NPM packages
variables.description: Additional npm packages to install, space separated.

variables.name: Uninstall NPM packages
variables.description: NPM packages to uninstall, space separated.

variables.name: Additional Node Arguments
variables.description: Any extra arguments passed to node/ts-node.

variables.name: Main file (Python)
variables.description: The Python file that starts the app when RUNTIME=python.

variables.name: Requirements file
variables.description: The requirements file to install with pip on startup and install, when RUNTIME=python.

variables.name: Additional pip packages
variables.description: Additional pip packages to install, space separated.

variables.name: Uninstall pip packages
variables.description: Pip packages to uninstall, space separated.

variables.name: Additional Python Arguments
variables.description: Any extra arguments passed to python3.
